The learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is a comprehensive and self-contained legislation. It being a special Act covering the domain of food safety and standards the provisions of the IPC would not apply and therefore, the instant FIR was not maintainable. The Investigating Agency had acted against the petitioners upon the report of the Food Safety Analyst (Annexure P-3) and the said analysis was conducted in accordance with the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Section 29 of the Act clearly shows that the police has been kept out of the ambit of the Act. The appointment of the food safety officers has been provided for under Section 37 of the Act and the powers of such officers has been provided under Section 38 of the Act. The powers to conduct search and seizure have been prescribed in Sections 41 and 42 of the Act.
